summary: Frontend-only validation (viewport 430x900) of the 4 new changes + regression. ALL 5 requested areas PASS: (A) hamburger menu no longer contains 'Kunci API Gemini' (menu-api count=0) nor any AI-status text; remaining 6 items present. (B) Pustaka shows exactly 52 topics (Fase A=12, B=14, C=14, D=12), every topic button renders a thumbnail , 0 broken images; clicking a topic opens kartu-panduan with a header illustration. (C) btn-kutipan generates a 1080x1920 canvas PNG (data URL, 249KB) rendered inside kutipan-modal with Simpan Gambar + Bagikan buttons, no JS crash/console error. (D) After 4 topic sessions, rapor-modal shows rapor-streak='1 hari', rapor-minggu-ini=4, rapor-lencana grid with lencana-Pemula data-unlocked=true and Rajin/Konsisten/Bintang/Juara/Legenda=false (correct per thresholds). (E) Regression: manual soal -> btn-susun-panduan renders kartu-panduan via Gemini (~ok), lock-slider-knob double-click reveals kunci-jawaban-terbuka, btn-tts clickable.

issues: 'Jenjang Kelas' uses a native browser <select> (data-testid=pilih-jenjang) instead of the shadcn Select component, so it renders the OS default picker and looks inconsistent with the rest of the rounded/branded UI on mobile

Several illustration photos are generic classroom/stock images with weak relation to the topic (e.g. 'Penjumlahan Kelereng' and 'Pengurangan Permen' show the same style classroom photo, 'Pola Bangun' shows a group photo). Cosmetic only - all images load (no 404s).

action_items: Optional: replace native <select data-testid=pilih-jenjang> with shadcn Select for visual consistency
Optional: swap a few Pustaka thumbnails for more topic-relevant imagery
critical_code_review_comments: RaporModal streak uses a 1-day tolerance (if today has no session it starts counting from yesterday). This means a user who studied only yesterday still sees streak=1 - intentional-looking but verify it is the desired product rule.

buatKutipan() relies on emoji + custom font rendering in canvas; fonts may not be loaded at draw time (no document.fonts.ready await), so on a cold load the quote image can fall back to a default font. Low risk, cosmetic.
btn-tts shows an error toast when no id-ID voice is available (expected in headless); label therefore does not toggle - no code defect.
seed_data_creation: localStorage cleared, then 4 Pustaka sessions (b1, a1, a2, a4) written to riwayat_bimbingan for the streak/badge test
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features (menu removal, 52-topic Pustaka with images, WA quote canvas image, Rapor streak+badges) verified working on the public preview URL. Regression of Susun Panduan + child-proof lock also OK. Only cosmetic notes remain: native <select> for Jenjang Kelas and generic stock thumbnails. Streak/badge tests require clearing localStorage key 'riwayat_bimbingan' first.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found this iteration.
